name: Planet Dragon
original_name: プラネット ドラゴン
source:
When Yoshitsune awoke from cryosleep, he found himself in space. Mankind had flown out to space and inhabited many planets. After many twists and turns, he acquired a cargo ship (and the excellent accompanying navigation support doll Sakura) and started a shipping company. However, it is now an era of lowered sexual desire where holding hands was akin to kissing. Labelled as a ‘lewd beast’ for following the customs from the past era, Yoshitsune awakened the sexual desires of the women around him, causing trouble non-stop.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/06/19/june-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
义经从冷冻睡眠中醒来时，发现自己身处太空。人类早已飞向宇宙，并在许多星球上建立了居所。历经曲折后，他得到了一艘货船（以及优秀的导航辅助人偶樱），创办了运输公司。然而，如今正处于性欲低下的时代，牵手就相当于接吻。义经因遵循旧时代的习俗而被称为“淫兽”，他唤醒了身边女性的性欲，麻烦也因此接连不断。
